purpose: Connect frozen A/B/C proxy candidates to an isolated copy of the actual Feature21/QMLP RTL; preserve the research question and existing releases.
seed_rule: First seed in the previous frozen list, not selected by accuracy; scientific comparisons retain all three seeds.
preflight: Independent Python integer rounding, raw C proxy to saved features, parameter/Scala multiplier binding and accumulator bounds before RTL execution.
verification: All 80450 existing clean validation clusters plus deterministic boundary clusters; compare every feature byte and both INT32 logits; input bubbles/output stalls; abort/restart and protocol framing.
acceptance: Zero mismatched bytes/logits, no timeout or unexpected status. This is implementation acceptance, not algorithm promotion or independent generalization confirmation.
isolation: New docs/log paths and generated Scala package only; old source, exports, bitstreams and frozen manifests unchanged.
cost_scope: No FPGA area/timing/energy conclusion from arithmetic, simulation cycles or model counts. Board measurements require a matching future SoC build, ELF and workload.
next_gate: Only after bit-exact standalone RTL, prepare isolated SoC integration and matched board protocol. Do not resume Gemmini or expand training implicitly.
